title: Vietnamese-Style Pork Curry
description: A fusion of Indian and Vietnamese flavors, this curry is a unique twist on traditional pork recipes.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the ginger and garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the pork and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the fish sauce, sugar (if using), and tomatoes. Stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the pork is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
